scenario_description:
Objective: Complete Arturo’s already-started tactile map locker pickup before the morning garden tour leaves visitor services.
Emerging Need: The kiosk claim opens, then the same locker release stops at claim-code verification and staff cannot hand over or move the kit without outside confirmation.
Decision Context: The schedule and desk contact make the outing real but not blocked; the pause notice, Arturo’s counter update, and a saved outing note define the narrow consented verification route.
Consequence: Timely confirmation can restart the same locker session while Arturo remains at the counter; after timeout, the kit is released and no same-tour replacement remains.

parameter.title: Arturo tactile garden map pickup
parameter.description: Arturo plans to pick up the reserved low-vision tactile map kit at visitor services before joining the family garden tour.
parameter.location: San Antonio Botanical Garden Visitor Services

parameter.name: SABOT Visitor Services Desk
aliases: San Antonio Botanical Garden accessibility desk
parameter.notes: Same-day tactile map locker support; desk email monitored for 10:00 pickups until 10:40.

parameter.content: I’m inside the visitor center now and taking the cane-access line for the 10:00 tactile map locker pickup. Phone speaker is on until I reach the counter.

parameter.subject: Locker claim opened: Wynn tactile map kit
parameter.body: Visitor-services kiosk session for Arturo Wynn began at 10:04. Staff scanned the reservation, but locker 3B is holding at claim-code verification. The counter cannot release or move the tactile map kit until the authorized claim code is confirmed by email to this desk. This open claim holds until 10:32 before the locker times out.

parameter.content: The kiosk still says waiting for claim-code verification. Staff told me not to leave the counter if the same session can restart before 10:32, and I can still make the cousin tour if it opens in the next few minutes.

parameter.subject: Locker claim timed out: Wynn tactile map kit
parameter.body: The10:04 locker3B claim session expired at10:32 without claim-code verification. The released tactile map kit has now been issued to a waiting visitor. No kit remains available for this morning's garden tour.
